notableFacts: The primary EHI export artifact is an 8-page PDF data dictionary created on 2023-11-28 that defines 7 export tables.
The dictionary explicitly states customers can export either an individual patient or all patients for a practice.
Field/type coverage is substantial (152 documented fields), but no machine-readable schema files were found.
No sample export payload files were available in the collected artifacts.
Several core clinical sections are documented as large free-text columns and some fields are marked as "multiple records" without serialization rules.
Vendor-hosted documentation URLs returned HTTP 403 during collection; artifacts were recovered from Wayback snapshots.
